channels.chat-frame: inside the Hermes desktop chat frame: hermes.send
channels.served: served over loopback: POST to the dashboard server
channels.static: opened from disk: a copyable CLI command is the only writer
channels.browser: leaf surface action: open a URL in the browser
channels.browser-local: bookmark stored only in this browser, never in the tracker
channels.local: run on this machine: executes the single-writer CLI and reloads the feed

app.title: Job Search OS
app.subtitle: Listings, status and the next action
notes: This file describes structure, semantics and actions only.
Renderers own layout, typography and terminal glyphs.
Node ids are global and stable: link to them, never to positions.

counts.total.meaning: listings known from every stored scan

counts.nudged.meaning: internal reminder raised, no application sent

counts.in_latest_scan.meaning: present in the newest AMS scan

feed.warnings.count.meaning: degraded source warnings in the feed

feed.degraded.meaning: at least one source was missing or unreadable

session.mode.meaning: how the page is being viewed

selection.listing_id.meaning: the listing the action group targets

filter.scan_only.meaning: show only rows present in the newest scan

filter.bookmarked_only.meaning: show only listings bookmarked in the tracker

statuses.label: New
statuses.meaning: Listed by AMS and not yet acted on. Nothing sent.

statuses.label: Reminder
statuses.meaning: A reminder was raised. No application sent yet.

statuses.label: Applied
statuses.meaning: Application submitted by the chosen channel. Evidence required.

statuses.label: Interview
statuses.meaning: A conversation is scheduled or happened.

statuses.label: Success
statuses.meaning: Offer or acceptance. The end of the pipeline in the good direction.

statuses.label: Blocked
statuses.meaning: Cannot proceed, for example a withdrawn listing or a missing document.

statuses.label: Fail
statuses.meaning: The employer said no, or the process ended without an offer.

statuses.label: Unclear
statuses.meaning: Outcome unknown: silence, a lost thread, or no evidence either way.

statuses.label: Skipped
statuses.meaning: Deliberately not pursued. Reason recorded in the note.

statuses.label: Expired
statuses.meaning: Deadline passed before an application was made.

stages.label: Not read
stages.meaning: In the scan, never opened. Opening it fills the first circle.

stages.label: Generating application
stages.meaning: Application documents generated from the profile.

stages.label: Control application
stages.meaning: Documents proof-read and signed off before sending.

stages.label: Sending out
stages.meaning: Application submitted to the employer. Evidence required.

stages.label: Confirming
stages.meaning: Receipt confirmed, usually by an email from the employer or AMS.

stages.label: Waiting
stages.meaning: Waiting for an answer. After 7 days this escalates to call/contact.

stages.label: Call/Contact
stages.meaning: The 7 day wait ran out: call or write the employer yourself.

stages.label: Interview
stages.meaning: The employer answered and a conversation is scheduled or done.

stages.label: Interview preparation
stages.meaning: Preparing the interview: research, answers, documents to bring.

stages.label: Waiting for outcome
stages.meaning: Interview done, waiting for the decision.

stages.label: Blocked
stages.meaning: Cannot proceed: withdrawn listing or missing document.

stages.label: Unclear
stages.meaning: No clear outcome; keep it visible instead of guessing.

pay_monthly_min.label: Monthly pay (ad, monthly basis)
pay_monthly_min.note: Extracted from the search card, the AMS general info, or the ad body, and only when that text states a monthly basis; absent is unknown, not zero.

pay_yearly_min.label: Yearly pay (ad, yearly basis)
pay_yearly_min.note: Extracted only when the ad states a yearly basis and no monthly one. Shown in place of a missing monthly figure; never converted to a monthly rate.

pay_basis.label: Pay basis stated in the ad
pay_basis.note: month, year, or empty when the ad states no comparable pay.

roles.label: Matched roles
roles.note: Scoring signal from scored_jobs.json, present only for listings the scorer matched.

full_text.label: Full listing text
full_text.note: Only an actual captured listing detail, never a search-card preview.

company_description.label: Unternehmensbeschreibung
company_description.note: companyIntroduction from the matching AMS detail response.

occupation.label: Beruf
occupation.note: The title in the AMS detail response, not the occupational group or search-card title.

job_description.label: Stellenbeschreibung
job_description.note: Complete summary from the matching AMS detail response, not a short card snippet.

general_info.label: Allgemeine Informationen
general_info.note: generalEqualitiyInfo from AMS if supplied by the publisher.

notes: Every field that comes from a listing is untrusted text and must be escaped by the renderer.
A listing absent from the latest scan is historical, never implied to be open.

stage_generated.label: Mark generating
notes: Every stage write lands through ams_nudge.py, by way of tools/dashboard.py mark.
Never show success before the writer returns zero.
The stage is the process truth; the coarse status is derived from it.

feedback.failure: No source link on this listing

stage_read.label: Mark read
notes: Fires on its own when a listing is opened for the first time.
Stage 0 is unread: every circle empty. Read fills the first one.

transports.template: undo the last stage change on {listing_id}

feedback.success: back at the stage it held before

loading.message: Loading listings from the AMS feed

empty.message: No listings match the current filters. Clear the search or pick another status.

degraded.message: One AMS source could not be read. Totals may be lower than the stored feed.

error.message: The tracker rejected the last update. Nothing was written.

tree.label: Workspace
tree.meaning: What the candidate looks at first: counts, then the listing list.

children.label: Overview
children.meaning: Totals and the newest scan in one glance.

children.label: Reminder
children.meaning: Reminder raised, nothing sent.

children.label: Latest scan
children.meaning: When the newest AMS scan ran, and over what area.

children.label: Listings
children.meaning: The working surface: find one role, read it, mark it.

children.label: Status
children.meaning: Every status in the taxonomy is reachable, including skipped and expired.

children.label: Reminder
children.meaning: Internal reminder raised; no application or employer contact is implied.

children.label: Current stage
children.meaning: Show listings in one exact process stage, independently of status and scope.

children.label: Bookmarked
children.meaning: Only the listings bookmarked in the tracker.

children.label: In latest scan
children.meaning: Off shows historical listings too; they are never implied to be open.

children.label: Action on the focused listing
children.meaning: One obvious primary action; the rest stay reachable without a wall of buttons.

children.label: Step back one stage
children.meaning: Walks the process stage one step back, from call/contact towards read.

children.label: Bookmark
children.meaning: Saved in the tracker itself; Bookmark appears on the main row and expanded listing, and the filter finds it again.

children.label: Rows
children.meaning: A row template: the same field list drives the terminal detail pane and the browser table.

children.label: Posted
children.meaning: Posting date, ISO. When no source carries one the feed falls back to when the scanner last saw the listing, and the row carries the EST flag.

children.label: Score
children.meaning: Ranking score shown before the listing flags.

children.label: Pay (ad, monthly or yearly)
children.meaning: Shows the monthly amount when the ad states one, otherwise the yearly amount under the ad's own wording, otherwise not stated. Used as a secondary sort after score.

children.label: Seen in latest AMS scan
children.meaning: Whether the listing was observed in the latest scan. This does not prove it is still open.

children.label: Type
children.meaning: Full time, part time or marginal, as AMS states it.

children.label: Group
children.meaning: AMS occupational group. Present for every listing in the current scan.

children.label: Matched roles
children.meaning: Scorer hits against the target roles, not a listing attribute. Empty means no match was recorded, not that the ad lacks roles.

children.label: Unternehmensbeschreibung
children.fallback: Not captured from the AMS detail page.
children.meaning: Publisher's company introduction from the matching AMS ad.

children.label: Beruf
children.fallback: Not captured from the AMS detail page.
children.meaning: Role as labelled Beruf in the AMS detail, not an inferred occupational group.

children.label: Stellenbeschreibung
children.fallback: Not captured from the AMS detail page.
children.meaning: Full AMS ad description, not the truncated search card.

children.label: Allgemeine Informationen
children.fallback: Not captured or not provided in the AMS detail.
children.meaning: Publisher's additional information, such as the monthly minimum pay.

children.label: Full listing text
children.fallback: AMS detail not captured yet. The listing may no longer be online. The search card below is incomplete.
children.meaning: Archived full AMS ad text. Structured sections above are shown separately when available.

children.label: Process stage
children.meaning: Where the application sits in the pipeline. The gauge is drawn from this.

flags.label: FRESH
flags.meaning: Posted within two days of the scan.

flags.label: MATCH
flags.meaning: The scorer matched at least one role from the taxonomy.

flags.label: STALE
flags.meaning: Not in the latest scan. Never treat it as open.

flags.label: EST
flags.meaning: No posting date in any source: the date shown is when the scanner last saw it.

tree.label: Review
tree.meaning: Scan freshness and source problems, kept out of the way when nothing is wrong.

children.text: Listings from older scans are historical. They are kept for context and are not open vacancies.

tree.label: Profile
tree.meaning: Local editable profile drafts; private source data is never bundled into the public page.

children.label: Skills
children.meaning: Edit a local skills draft with a source for each claim; export for review.

tree.label: Tracker
tree.meaning: The registers behind the counts. Only shown when it holds something.

tree.label: System
tree.meaning: How the page is running and how to get out of a broken path.

children.label: Terminal fallback
children.text: Marking from a file:// page needs the served build, the chat frame, or: python3 -B tools/dashboard.py mark <id> applied

tabs.label: Listings
tabs.meaning: The working surface: find one role, read it, mark it.

tabs.label: Overview
tabs.meaning: Counts and the last scan at a glance.

tabs.label: Review
tabs.meaning: What the last scan produced, and any source warnings.

tabs.label: Profile
tabs.meaning: Browser-only local Skills draft editor; no private source data is published.

tabs.label: Tracker
tabs.meaning: Listings that left the new pool.

tabs.label: System
tabs.meaning: Keys, refresh, and the terminal fallback.
